_comment: Curated Ollama-ID -> entity-tuple OVERRIDE table for the offline Ollama refresh tool (cmd/bestiary-ollama). It is consulted FIRST and takes PRECEDENCE over the mechanical join (curated > mechanical, matching the parse/ curated-overrides precedent), because the cases it covers are wrong-POSITIVES, not misses: an Ollama default size tag (e.g. 'llama3.3:70b', 'llama3.1:8b') serves the instruction-tuned weights but the tag string omits the '-instruct' modifier, so the bare mechanical decomposition produces an EntityRef key (llama@3.3#70b / llama@3.1#8b) that DOES match the catalog — but the wrong rows: the bare llama@3.3#70b key collapses 34 community-merge variants (e.g. Llama-3.3-70B-Anthrobomination), and llama@3.1#8b matches non-instruct provider variants (e.g. cerebras/llama-3.1-8b-cs). Each alias re-adds the instruct modifier so the join lands on the instruct entity (llama-3.3-70b-instruct / llama-3.1-8b-instruct). KEYING: keys are lowercased Ollama IDs; the quant-stripped form is matched first, then the verbatim form, so one entry covers every quant variant. param_size is a canonical token (ParseParamSize shape, e.g. '70b'); modifier is the IDENTITY-class modifier list (EntityModifiers projection). This file is hand-curated seed data; the tool never rewrites it. (Bare size-only tags whose mechanical key MISSES the catalog entirely, e.g. qwen2.5:7b, do not need an alias — the tool's default-tag instruct fallback reaches the instruct entity for them.)
